title: hexporter: GPU jobs & idle detection
description: hexporter v1: GPU -> PBS job -> user, idle detection, DCGM pipes, health, shared filesystems

panels.title: Allocated
panels.description: GPUs held by a job (PBS, or a process outside PBS)

targets.expr: count(count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Idle
panels.description: Held by a job, utilization ≤ $idle_threshold % for at least $idle_minutes min

targets.expr: count(((max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) group_left () ((((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(count by (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance"}))[24h:1m])) + on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () (min by (instance, gpu_uuid) (time() - max_over_time(timestamp(hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"} > $idle_threshold)[24h:1m])) or (count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}) * 0 + 1e9))) - abs((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(count by (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance"}))[24h:1m])) - on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () (min by (instance, gpu_uuid) (time() - max_over_time(timestamp(hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"} > $idle_threshold)[24h:1m])) or (count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}) * 0 + 1e9)))) / 2)) >= $idle_minutes * 60)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Idle share
panels.description: Idle allocated GPUs / allocated GPUs

targets.expr: (count(((max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) group_left () ((((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(count by (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance"}))[24h:1m])) + on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () (min by (instance, gpu_uuid) (time() - max_over_time(timestamp(hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"} > $idle_threshold)[24h:1m])) or (count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}) * 0 + 1e9))) - abs((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(count by (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance"}))[24h:1m])) - on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () (min by (instance, gpu_uuid) (time() - max_over_time(timestamp(hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"} > $idle_threshold)[24h:1m])) or (count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}) * 0 + 1e9)))) / 2)) >= $idle_minutes * 60)) or vector(0)) / count(count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"})))

panels.title: Free (no job)
panels.description: GPUs no job or process is using

targets.expr: count(count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}) unless on (instance, gpu_uuid) hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPU-h held
panels.description: GPU-hours held by jobs in the selected time range (1-minute resolution)

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time((count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"})) > bool 0)[$__range:1m])) / 60

panels.title: GPU-h idle
panels.description: GPU-hours held by jobs while utilization was ≤ $idle_threshold % (minute by minute)

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"} <= bool $idle_threshold) * on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () (count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"})) > bool 0))[$__range:1m])) / 60

panels.title: Jobs: GPUs held and idle
panels.description: All GPUs idle for = how long every GPU of the job has been idle. Avg util over the last $idle_minutes min.

targets.expr: count by (jobid, user, queue, job_name) (max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}))

count by (jobid, user, queue, job_name) (((max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) group_left () ((((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(count by (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance"}))[24h:1m])) + on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () (min by (instance, gpu_uuid) (time() - max_over_time(timestamp(hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"} > $idle_threshold)[24h:1m])) or (count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}) * 0 + 1e9))) - abs((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(count by (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance"}))[24h:1m])) - on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () (min by (instance, gpu_uuid) (time() - max_over_time(timestamp(hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"} > $idle_threshold)[24h:1m])) or (count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}) * 0 + 1e9)))) / 2)) >= $idle_minutes * 60)) or count by (jobid, user, queue, job_name) (max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"})) * 0

min by (jobid, user, queue, job_name) ((max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) group_left () ((((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(count by (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance"}))[24h:1m])) + on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () (min by (instance, gpu_uuid) (time() - max_over_time(timestamp(hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"} > $idle_threshold)[24h:1m])) or (count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}) * 0 + 1e9))) - abs((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(count by (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance"}))[24h:1m])) - on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () (min by (instance, gpu_uuid) (time() - max_over_time(timestamp(hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"} > $idle_threshold)[24h:1m])) or (count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}) * 0 + 1e9)))) / 2)))

avg by (jobid, user, queue, job_name) (max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () avg_over_time(hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}[${idle_minutes}m]))

sum by (jobid, user, queue, job_name) (max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () hpc_gpu_memory_used_bytes{instance=~"$instance"})

sum by (jobid, user, queue, job_name) (max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () hpc_gpu_power_draw_watts{instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Idle GPUs: held by a job, ≤ $idle_threshold % for ≥ $idle_minutes min
panels.description: Idle for = shorter of (time since last busy) and (time since the job got the GPU); max ~24 h.

targets.expr: ((max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) group_left () ((((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(count by (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance"}))[24h:1m])) + on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () (min by (instance, gpu_uuid) (time() - max_over_time(timestamp(hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"} > $idle_threshold)[24h:1m])) or (count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}) * 0 + 1e9))) - abs((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(count by (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance"}))[24h:1m])) - on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () (min by (instance, gpu_uuid) (time() - max_over_time(timestamp(hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"} > $idle_threshold)[24h:1m])) or (count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}) * 0 + 1e9)))) / 2)) >= $idle_minutes * 60)

panels.title: GPU state over time
panels.description: Free = no PBS job · Idle = PBS job holds it at ≤ $idle_threshold % · Busy outside PBS = work without a PBS job · Busy = PBS job computing

targets.expr: (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"} > bool $idle_threshold) * 2 + on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () (clamp_max(count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", jobid!="none"}), 1) or count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}) * 0)
max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}
max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () hpc_gpu_sm_active_ratio{instance=~"$instance"}
max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () hpc_gpu_pipe_active_ratio{instance=~"$instance", pipe="tensor"}
max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () hpc_gpu_memory_used_bytes{instance=~"$instance"}
max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () hpc_gpu_power_draw_watts{instance=~"$instance"}

(max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) group_left () ((((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(count by (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance"}))[24h:1m])) + on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () (min by (instance, gpu_uuid) (time() - max_over_time(timestamp(hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"} > $idle_threshold)[24h:1m])) or (count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}) * 0 + 1e9))) - abs((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(count by (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance"}))[24h:1m])) - on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () (min by (instance, gpu_uuid) (time() - max_over_time(timestamp(hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"} > $idle_threshold)[24h:1m])) or (count by (instance, gpu_uuid) (hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}) * 0 + 1e9)))) / 2))
max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"}
avg by (user) (max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () hpc_gpu_utilization_percent{instance=~"$instance"})
count by (user) (count by (instance, gpu_uuid, user) (max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"})))
count by (framework) (count by (instance, gpu_uuid, framework) (max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"})))
count by (queue) (count by (instance, gpu_uuid, queue) (max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"})))

panels.title: Compute pipes by job
panels.description: Share of time each pipe was busy (DCGM profiling). Tensor ≈ matrix math (AI); fp64 ≈ HPC/scientific

targets.expr: avg by (jobid, pipe) (hpc_gpu_pipe_active_ratio{instance=~"$instance", pipe=~"tensor|fp64|fp32|fp16|int"} * on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left (jobid) max by (instance, gpu_uuid, jobid) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}))

panels.title: SM active per GPU
panels.description: Fraction of SMs with work; more accurate than utilization, which only says a kernel was running

panels.title: GPU memory used
panels.description: High memory with 0 % utilization = model loaded but no requests

targets.expr: max without (source) (hpc_gpu_job_info{instance=~"$instance", user=~"$user"}) * on (instance, gpu_uuid) group_left () hpc_gpu_memory_used_bytes{instance=~"$instance"}

panels.title: DCGM up
panels.description: Share of nodes reading DCGM; below 100 % = nvidia-smi fallback somewhere

panels.title: XID errors
panels.description: Last XID error code is not 0 (since nv-hostengine started)

panels.title: Remap failures
panels.description: GPU needs a reset or RMA

panels.title: Too hot now
panels.description: GPUs slowed down because they are too hot

panels.title: Unreadable
panels.description: Above 0: exporter not root, job mapping incomplete

panels.title: Power-capped time
panels.description: Fraction of time clocks were lowered to stay under the power limit. Normal under heavy load

panels.title: Thermal-throttled time
panels.description: Fraction of time clocks were lowered because the GPU was too hot. Should be 0

panels.title: Hung mounts
panels.description: statfs did not answer within FS_STAT_TIMEOUT

targets.expr: max by (instance, mountpoint, fstype, mount_type, server) (hpc_fs_info{instance=~"$instance", mount_type=~"nfs|parallel|smb|fuse"})
max by (instance, mountpoint) (hpc_fs_stat_duration_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}) and on (instance, mountpoint) hpc_fs_responsive{instance=~"$instance", mount_type=~"nfs|parallel|smb|fuse"}

max by (instance, mountpoint) (hpc_disk_used_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} / hpc_disk_total_bytes{instance=~"$instance"}) and on (instance, mountpoint) hpc_fs_responsive{instance=~"$instance", mount_type=~"nfs|parallel|smb|fuse"}
sum by (instance, mountpoints) (rate(hpc_nfs_rpc_rtt_milliseconds_total{instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) / sum by (instance, mountpoints) (rate(hpc_nfs_rpc_ops_total{instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

panels.title: statfs time per mount
panels.description: Time for a df-style call on each shared mount; a jump means the server is slow

panels.title: Scrape time
panels.description: Prometheus scrape_timeout is 30 s
